note: Captured by running BOTOR's own compiler inside the grid-editor checkout, so this fixture is independent of the vendored copy. cost().used is max(compressed, raw) + reserved and the raw length wins for all nine presets, so it cannot see a minifier regression. The compressed lengths are recorded separately and are what the D-11 bump gate asserts.

aurora.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.paurora]] for n=0,80 do local a=glag(0,n)glc(a,2,0,85,255,1)glpfs(a,2,(n%9+n//9)*15,2,3)glt(a,2,65535)glc(a,1,255,170,34,1)end self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)local a=glag(0,x*9//128+y*9//128*9)glpfs(a,1,255,250,0)glt(a,1,42)end gtt(0,3e5)

pinwheel.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.ppinwheel]] for n=0,80 do local a=glag(0,n)glc(a,2,0,102,255,1)glpfs(a,2,math.atan(n//9-4,n%9-4)*41//1%256,2,3)glt(a,2,65535)end self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)if e~=3 and e<5 then local a=glag(0,x*9//128+y*9//128*9)glc(a,1,255-i*60,i*60,128,1)glpfs(a,1,255,250,0)glt(a,1,42)end end gtt(0,3e5)

radar.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.pradar]] for n=0,80 do local a,u,v=glag(0,n),n%9-4,n//9-4 glc(a,2,255,68,0,1)glpfs(a,2,math.sqrt(u*u+v*v)*45//1,254,3)glt(a,2,65535)glc(a,1,255,170,34,1)end self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)local a=glag(0,x*9//128+y*9//128*9)glpfs(a,1,255,250,0)glt(a,1,42)if(e==4 or e==9)and not s.f then s.f=i end if i==s.f then if e==1 or e==4 then s:gms(0,176,16,x,0)s:gms(0,176,17,y,0)end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.f=nil end end end gtt(0,3e5)

joystick.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.pjoystick]] for a=0,80 do glc(a,1,255,187,0,1)end self.l=76 glp(glag(0,76),1,255)self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)if s.l then glp(glag(0,s.l),1,0)end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.l=nil else s.l=x*9//128+y*9//128*9 glp(glag(0,s.l),1,255)end if(e==4 or e==9)and not s.f then s.f=i end if i==s.f then if e==1 or e==4 then s:gms(0,224,0,x,0)s:gms(0,176,17,127-y,0)end if e==3 or e>=5 then s:gms(0,224,0,64,0)s:gms(0,176,17,0,0)end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.f=nil end end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.l=76 glp(glag(0,76),1,255)end end gtt(0,3e5)

ninepads.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.pninepads]] for n=0,80 do local a=glag(0,n)local zx,zy=n%9//3,n//9//3 if(zx+zy)%2==0 then glc(a,1,0,68,204,1)else glc(a,1,0,27,81,1)end glp(a,1,255)glc(a,2,255,136,34,1)glp(a,2,0)end self.n={}self.p={}self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)local z=x*3//128+y*3//128*3 if e==3 or e>=5 then z=nil end local o=s.n[i]if o~=z then if o then s:gms(0,128,36+o,0,0)end if z then s:gms(0,144,36+z,100,0)end s.n[i]=z for m=0,80 do local q=m%9//3+m//9//3*3 if q==o or q==z then glp(glag(0,m),2,q==z and 255 or 0)end end end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.p[i]=nil else s.p[i]=0 end end gtt(0,20)
ninepads.timerLua: --[[@cb#z.t]] gtt(0,20)local s=self for i,t in pairs(s.p)do s.p[i]=t+1 if t>100 then if s.n[i]then s:gms(0,128,36+s.n[i],0,0)s.n[i]=nil end s.p[i]=nil end end

faders.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.pfaders]] for n=0,80 do local a=glag(0,n)local c=n%9 if c%2==1 then local f=c//2 glc(a,1,f*85,255-f*20,255-f*85,1)glc(a,2,f*85,255-f*20,255-f*85,1)glp(a,1,0)glp(a,2,0)else glc(a,1,255,255,255,1)glc(a,2,255,255,255,1)glp(a,1,255)glp(a,2,255)end end self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)if e==1 or e==4 then local f=x*4//128 local v=127-y s:gms(0,176,16+f,v,0)local l=(v+1)*9//128 for n=0,80 do if n%9==f*2+1 then local w=(8-n//9)<l and 255 or 0 local a=glag(0,n)glp(a,1,w)glp(a,2,w)end end end end gtt(0,3e5)

dial.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.pdial]] for n=0,80 do local a=glag(0,n)glc(a,2,255,170,0,1)glpfs(a,2,math.atan(n//9-4,n%9-4)*123//1%256,2,3)glt(a,2,65535)glc(a,1,255,170,34,1)end self.d=0 self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)local a=glag(0,x*9//128+y*9//128*9)glpfs(a,1,255,250,0)glt(a,1,42)if e==4 and not s.f then s.f=i end if i==s.f then local u,v=2*x-127,2*y-127 if u*u+v*v>1444 then local a=math.atan(v,u)*652//1 local d=a-(s.a or a)s.a=a if d>2048 then d=d-4096 elseif d<-2048 then d=d+4096 end s.d=s.d+d local n=(s.d+32)//64 if n~=0 then s.d=s.d-n*64 s:gms(0,176,16,glim(64+n,1,127),0)end else s.a=nil end if e==3 or e>=5 then s.f=nil s.a=nil end end end gtt(0,3e5)

tpad.setupLua: --[[@cb#z.ptpad]] self:txma(1023)self:tyma(1023)gmbs(3,0)self.r=0 self.z=function(s)s.p={}s.n=0 s.k=0 s.m=0 s.w=0 s.j=0 s.q=0 end self:z()self.touch_cb=function(s,i,e,x,y)if s.q>25 then s:z()end s.q=0 local o,g,f,h=true,0,0,0 while o and g<24 do g=g+1 local c,t=s.p[i],e==3 or e>=5 if e==4 or e>7 or not c and not t then if not c then s.n=s.n+1 s.k=glim(s.k,s.n,9)end c={x,y}s.p[i]=c s.j=4 end if t then if c then s.p[i]=nil s.n=s.n-1 s.j=4 if s.n<1 then if s.r<1 and e>4 and s.m<s.k*120 then gmbs(glim(s.k,1,2),1)s.r=4 end gtt(0,20)s:z()end end else local u,v=x-c[1],y-c[2]c[1]=x c[2]=y s.m=s.m+math.abs(u)+math.abs(v)if s.n>1 then s.w=s.w+v else f=f+u h=h+v end end o=s:touch_pop()i=s:tid()e=s:tev()x=s:txv()y=s:tyv()end if s.j>0 then s.j=s.j-1 elseif s.n>1 then local d=(s.w+64)//128 if d~=0 then s.w=s.w-d*128 s.m=999 gmms(3,-d)end else gmms(1,glim(f,-63,63))gmms(2,glim(h,-63,63))end end gtt(0,20)
tpad.timerLua: --[[@cb#z.t]] gtt(0,20)local s=self if s.n then if s.r>0 then s.r=s.r-1 if s.r<1 then gmbs(3,0)end end s.q=s.q+1 if s.q==100 then gmbs(3,0)end end
